stories.title: More electric vehicles exempt from luxury tax, Ottawa says
stories.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne announced that starting Friday, all electric vehicles that cost less than $150,000 would be exempt from the 10 per cent tax.

stories.title: Beer recall hits 2 more Canadian products, bringing total to 31
stories.summary: Quebec-based Archibald Inc. issued the recall for its Nuit Blanche White IPA 473 ml cans as well as four packs due to pieces of metal.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens win convincingly over the Bruins in Boston
stories.summary: It was the first time that the Montreal Canadiens battled for first place in a head-to-head this season. It doesn't get bigger the Bruins in Boston. The Habs score a solid 5-2 win.

stories.title: Akwesasne elder makes history as first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous languages PhD program
stories.summary: At 73, Mary Onwá Tekahawáhkwen Macdonald is the first graduate of McGill’s Indigenous language revitalization PhD program.

stories.title: Quebec City has emerged as leading contender for CFL expansion: commissioner
stories.summary: CFL commissioner Stewart Johnston says Quebec City has emerged as a leading candidate for an expansion franchise.

stories.title: Elks kicker Blanchard wrote it down in 2026
stories.summary: Vincent Blanchard began writing things down this season.

stories.title: Generations Foundation holiday food and toy drive kicks off: Here’s where to donate
stories.summary: The Generations Foundation’s annual holiday food and toy drive is underway. Here’s where to donate toys, non-perishable food and money to support Montreal families in need.

stories.title: Association of Quebec farmers releases study challenging costs of high-speed rail
stories.summary: The study conducted by Vision Transport and agricultural group Union des producteurs agricoles say these savings could be made by modernizing existing tracks.

stories.title: Pilot killed in Quebec Remembrance Day plane crash identified
stories.summary: A pilot who died Wednesday when his plane crashed after participating in a Remembrance Day ceremony south of Quebec City has been identified.

stories.title: Montrealers pay tribute to war veterans at annual Remembrance Day ceremony
stories.summary: Retired lieutenant-colonel Colin Robinson said Remembrance Day is an opportunity for Canadians to reflect on the dangers of war, particularly amid current global tensions.
